title: Qatl Bhai Ho Raha
body:
qatl bhai ho raha hai di ye zainab ne sada
oonchi hokar ay zameen tu mujhko ye manzar dikha
<<DIVIDER>>
hukm sun kar sayyeda ka ho gayi oonchi zameen
bhai ko dekha to na tha zeen pe na bar zameen
teeron talwaron mein tha mazloom shaah e karbala
oonchi hokar ay zameen tu mujhko ye manzar dikha
qatl bhai ho raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl pyasa zer e khanjar ho raha shabbir hai
zaalimon se keh rahi ro ro ke ye hamsheer hai
yun sitam dhao na tum bhai mera hai bekhata
oonchi hokar ay zameen tu mujhko ye manzar dikha
qatl bhai ho raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
najaf se aaye ali baqaiye se aayi fatema
peet'te sar ko thay apne karte thay aah o fughan
aur thay girya kuna maqtal mein shaah e ambiya
oonchi hokar ay zameen tu mujhko ye manzar dikha
qatl bhai ho raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala mein shaah e deen ne aakhri sajda kiya
tera zarbon se layeen ne sar kiya tan se juda
khoon barsa aasmaan se tha andhera chaa gaya
oonchi hokar ay zameen tu mujhko ye manzar dikha
qatl bhai ho raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad e qatl e sheh chali khursheed gham ki aandhiyan
aa gaya shabbir ka sar bar sar e nok e sina
haye mere bhai ka hai bin sar kahan laasha pada
oonchi hokar ay zameen tu mujhko ye manzar dikha
qatl bhai ho raha hai...
author: Haider Khursheed
